title: Critical Hausdorff Measure for Higher-Dimensional Bedford-McMullen Subshifts
summary: Let $Λ=\operatorname{diag}(m_1,\ldots,m_d)$ be a diagonal expanding integer matrix with $m_1\ge\cdots\ge m_d\ge2$ and at least two distinct diagonal entries, and let $X\subset\mathcal A^{\mathbb N}$ be a subshift with weak specification over $\mathcal A=\prod_{r=1}^d\{0,1,\ldots,m_r-1\}$. Let $K=R(X)$ be the corresponding self-affine set.
